福爾摩沙小導遊臺南 Tainan・東區

府城宣教足跡Mission Trail of Old Tainan

從 1865 年一間小診所開始，長老教會在府城留下了醫院、學校和臺灣第一份報紙。我們用歷史與文化的角度，一站一站走走看。

Starting from one small clinic in 1865, Presbyterian missionaries left hospitals, schools and Taiwan's first newspaper in Tainan.

走在府城，你會找到有共同故事的醫院、學校和教堂。1865 年，蘇格蘭醫生馬雅各在看西街開了診所和禮拜堂。謠言逼他南下打狗，但他又回來了，他的工作後來成為新樓醫院。宣教師辦學校：1876 年神學院、1885 年中學、1887 年女學校。1885 年，巴克禮印出臺灣第一份報紙，用羅馬字寫臺語。今天，你可以從太平境教會走到大東門，看完整條足跡。

Walk through old Tainan and you can find hospitals, schools and churches with a shared story. In 1865, Dr. James Maxwell, a Scottish physician, opened a clinic and chapel on Kanxi Street. Rumors forced him south to Takao, but he came back, and his work grew into Sin-lau Hospital. The missionaries opened schools: a theological college in 1876, a middle school in 1885 and a girls' school in 1887. In 1885, Thomas Barclay printed Taiwan's first newspaper, written in Taiwanese with Roman letters. Today you can walk from Tai Peng Ching Church to the East Gate and see the whole trail.

一分鐘看懂

One-minute intro

為什麼值得來

Why it matters & history
  1. 馬雅各醫生來了1865 年，蘇格蘭醫生馬雅各在府城開始醫療宣教。In 1865, a Scottish doctor began his medical mission in Tainan.
  2. 醫院與教會醫療和信仰一起走，留下了醫院與教堂。Medicine and faith went together and left a hospital and churches.
  3. 辦學校長老教會在府城辦了臺灣最早的一批西式學校。The Presbyterians opened some of Taiwan's earliest Western-style schools in Tainan.
  4. 巴克禮與第一份報紙巴克禮牧師用印刷機，印出臺灣第一份報紙。Thomas Barclay used a printing press to make Taiwan's first newspaper.

認識景點

About the place

馬雅各醫生來了Dr. Maxwell arrives

蘇格蘭醫生：馬雅各（James Laidlaw Maxwell）是英國長老教會派來的宣教醫師。 1865 年 6 月 16 日：他在府城西門外的看西街租屋，前面看病、後面講道。這一天成為臺灣基督長老教會的設教紀念日。 謠言四起：外國醫生很少見，有人散播可怕的謠言，群眾包圍診所。 南下打狗：只過了幾個星期，他只好離開府城，到打狗（今高雄）繼續行醫。

A Scottish physician: James Laidlaw Maxwell was a doctor sent by the English Presbyterian Church. 16 June 1865: He rented a house on Kanxi Street, treating patients at the front and preaching at the back. Rumors spread: Foreign doctors were rare, and frightening rumors spread about him. South to Takao: After only a few weeks, he had to leave and moved south to Takao.

再回府城：幾年後他回到府城，醫療工作慢慢被接受。 宣教師：被派到遠方傳揚信仰的人。

Back to the city: A few years later he came back, and people slowly accepted his work. missionary: A person sent far away to share their faith.

醫院與教會A hospital and a church

看西街教會：紀念馬雅各最早工作的地方，是臺南最早的長老教會之一。 新樓醫院：1900 年在東門一帶蓋起新醫院，延續馬雅各的醫療工作，至今仍在服務。 太平境教會：1902 年落成的教堂以馬雅各命名，就在湯德章紀念公園圓環旁。 醫院：給病人看病、住院的地方。

Kanxi Street Church: It remembers where Maxwell first worked in 1865. Sin-lau Hospital: A new hospital opened near the East Gate in 1900 and still serves Tainan. Tai Peng Ching Church: The church of 1902 was named after Maxwell. It stands by the big roundabout. hospital: A place where sick people are treated.

禮拜堂：做禮拜的小教堂。

chapel: A small place for worship.

辦學校Opening schools

臺南神學院：1876 年創立，培養本地傳道人，今天在東門路上。 長榮中學：1885 年創立，當時叫長老教中學，是臺灣最早的中學之一。 長榮女中：1887 年的長老教女學校。當時很少女孩能上學，這所學校為女孩打開了教室的門。 神學院：研究信仰、培養傳道人的學校。

Tainan Theological College: Founded in 1876 to train local preachers. Today it is on Dongmen Road. Chang Jung Senior High School: It opened in 1885 as the Presbyterian Middle School. Chang Jung Girls' High School: In 1887, a school for girls opened when few girls could study. theological college: A school that trains church leaders.

巴克禮與第一份報紙Barclay and the first newspaper

巴克禮牧師：來自蘇格蘭格拉斯哥的宣教師，在臺南工作了六十年。 印刷機：為府城募來一臺印刷機，巴克禮還特地回格拉斯哥學排版。 府城教會報：1885 年 7 月 12 日第一期出刊，是臺灣第一份報紙，今天仍以《臺灣教會公報》發行。 白話字：用羅馬字母拼寫臺語，學幾個星期就能讀報。

Thomas Barclay: A missionary from Glasgow who worked in Tainan for sixty years. printing press: A printing press was given, and Barclay learned typesetting in Glasgow. Taiwan Church News: The first issue came out on 12 July 1885. It is still published today. Roman letters: Taiwanese written in Roman letters. People could learn to read it in weeks.

巴克禮紀念公園：東區的大公園，以他的名字紀念他。

Barclay Memorial Park: A big park in the East District remembers him.

實景照片

Photos on site

中庭與新樓醫院 The courtyard and Sin-lau Hospital

神學院的中庭有草地和噴水池，四周是拱廊建築。後方那棟白色大樓，就是延續馬雅各醫生醫療工作的新樓醫院。

The college courtyard has lawns and a fountain, with arched walkways all around. The white building behind it is Sin-lau Hospital, which carries on the medical work Dr. Maxwell began.

巴克禮紀念教會 Barclay Memorial Church

巴克禮紀念教會的入口：白色圓柱撐起半圓形的門廊，上面的白話字寫著 TÂI-LÂM TANG-MN̂G PA-KHEK-LÊ KÌ-LIĀM KÀU-HŌE，也就是「台南東門巴克禮紀念教會」。

This is the entrance porch of the Barclay Memorial Church. White columns hold up a round porch. The romanized Taiwanese above them means Tainan East Gate Barclay Memorial Church.

教會正面 The church front

教會的正面：紅磚牆、白色門廊，屋頂上有十字架。旁邊高樓上直寫著「台南東門巴克禮紀念教會」，上面也有同樣的燃燒荊棘徽章。

Here is the front of the church, with red-brick walls, a white porch, and a cross on top. The tall building beside it shows the church's Chinese name and the same burning bush emblem.
